We're in a wild Pidgey battle on Route 2. Squirtle L8 HP 20/25, enemy Pidgey L5 HP 14/19. Screen shows "SQUIRTLE used TACKLE!" — mid-turn text. Notes say consider catching Pidgey for Fly later. We have 4 Poke Balls. Pidgey at 14/19 HP (~74%) — catch rate for Pidgey is 255, so even at full HP with a Poke Ball it's decent. Actually Pidgey catch rate 255, at 14/19 HP with Poke Ball: chance roughly (255/255)*(1/3)... formula: a = ((3*maxHP - 2*curHP)*rate*ball)/(3*maxHP) = ((57-28)*255*1)/57 = 29*255/57 ≈ 129.75. Ball shake probability... with a≈130, catch chance ≈ (a/255) * ... actually for a>=255 auto catch; else b = 1048560/sqrt(sqrt(16711680/a))... roughly catch probability ~ (a/255)^... Let me recall: Gen 1 catch probability ≈ (a/255) * (shake check)^... The approximate formula: probability = (a/255) * ... hmm. Common approximation: catch chance ≈ (a/255) for low... Actually Gen1: if a >= 255 catch. Else b = 65536 / (255/a)^(1/4)... four shake checks each with probability b/65536 = (a/255)^(1/4). So catch prob = (a/255). So a≈130 → ~51% catch chance. Weakening more would help. One more Tackle would bring it to maybe 7-9 HP, raising a to ((57-16)*255)/57 ≈ 183 → 72%. But risk of killing: Tackle at L8 vs L5 Pidgey does ~5-7 damage. 14 HP, two more tackles could kill. One more Tackle then ball is reasonable. Or just throw ball now at 51%.

We have 4 balls and want a Pidgey for Fly eventually (Pidgeot can Fly; Pidgey line yes). Also catching gives dex entry and XP. Let's do: a_until_dialog_end to finish current text and get to menu, then throw a Poke Ball.

How to use item in battle: From FIGHT/PM/ITEM/RUN menu, ITEM is at position... Gen 1 battle menu: FIGHT (top-left), PKMN (top-right), ITEM (bottom-left), RUN (bottom-right). Cursor starts at FIGHT. To select ITEM: walk_down then press_a. Then item list opens; Poke Ball is first item (bag: Poke Ball x4, Antidote x3). Press_a selects first item (Poke Ball), then maybe quantity? In Gen 1, selecting item uses it directly (no quantity menu for balls? Actually in Gen 1 there's no quantity selection in battle; selecting item uses one).
